recovery_reason.stale_state: The implementation, focused test, and evidence remained merged while the current generated reconciliation still classified the operation PENDING.
recovery_reason.security_correction: The prior Laravel route used only web middleware. A live reread of the authoritative ASP.NET Program.cs shows AuthorizationOptions.FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser(), and Error.razor does not opt out with AllowAnonymous. The recovered Laravel route therefore restores web + auth while intentionally keeping tenant.context off the zero-parameter global error route.

source_behavior.purpose: Render a safe error center with Error ID, Correlation ID and error time while directing full diagnostics to server logs.
source_behavior.sensitive_detail_policy: The route page itself states that sensitive technical details are not exposed.
source_behavior.tracking_fallback: The source falls back to the current HTTP trace identifier when dedicated ErrorId/CorrelationId items are absent.
source_behavior.authorization_boundary: Authenticated by the application-wide ASP.NET fallback policy; the page has no AllowAnonymous override and no tenant route parameter.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: Authenticated sessions receive the safe error surface. The controller rereads request_id and correlation_id normalized by RequestCorrelation and renders only bounded tracking data plus current error time. Query parameters, exception messages and stack traces are not rendered. Any Logs destination already present in the controller is derived only from authorized memberships and is not caller-selected.

security_and_tenancy.adaptation: authenticated-session global route with no caller-selected tenant or resource identifier
security_and_tenancy.source_auth_proof: src/AIWordPressManager.Web/Program.cs configures FallbackPolicy with RequireAuthenticatedUser(); src/AIWordPressManager.Web/Components/Pages/Error.razor declares /Error and no AllowAnonymous override.
proof: The route has zero tenant/resource parameters, so there is no direct IDOR surface.
RequestCorrelation accepts only bounded identifier characters and generates a UUID when caller identifiers are invalid.
The Blade view uses escaped interpolation and never consumes query-string exception/error payloads.
Authenticated users without eligible tenant memberships receive identity-neutral content with no tenant path or personal data disclosure.
No caller-supplied tenant, user, membership or resource identifier is accepted by the route contract.

assertions: canonical operation metadata and exact /Error source identity
reference Program.cs fallback authentication and absence of Error.razor AllowAnonymous override
explicit ErrorReadController route with web + auth, no tenant.context, and zero parameters
invalid caller tracking headers are replaced and not reflected
query-supplied secrets/exception details are not rendered
authenticated Alpha/Beta identity non-disclosure with no synthesized tenant route

terminality.basis: Recovered source-equivalent authenticated route behavior, deterministic fail-closed acceptance, exact pushed provenance, and official generator recognition are all required before terminal credit.
